reference_sources.evidence: Public 1600x900 opening frame: quiet icon navigation, bounded reading area and compact composer
Public marketing capture: independent floating round header targets and a pill title
Current public store marketing screenshots: staggered two-line menu, square-pencil action and compact single-row composer. Optional work selectors are a documented adaptation.

ownership: Reusable geometry, control presentation and drawer interaction belong to the kit; routes, data, drafts and permissions remain controlled by the Host.
limitations: Store screenshots do not establish their capture date, drawer appearance, dark theme or transition timings
Panel duration is a documented adaptation until native timing can be measured
No claim of full native ChatGPT client equivalence from these partial references
Existing DesktopClientSurface keeps its independently measured Windows package profile
